Definition: for the genitive case of G3748 (as adverb); during which same time, i.e. whilst:--whiles.
BiblicalUsage: hótou means while, until. In Matthew 5:25, the text says "whiles thou art in the way with him."
TheologicalSignificance: Out of hótou I do not force more than it gives: while, until.
RelatedTopics: Word of God; Faith; Christian Life
RelatedEvents: The Sermon on the Mount; The Healing of the Man Born Blind; The Parable of the Barren Fig Tree
